description: This header file defines the MiracastP2P class which manages Wi-Fi Peer-to-Peer (P2P) connections and related P2P events, commands, and configurations for Miracast streaming. It includes enums for P2P interfaces and events, as well as interfaces for device discovery, connection, and parameter management.
